issues: src/navigation/index.ts: This file contains JSX but has a .ts extension, leading to a TypeScript syntax error (unexpected token at line 38) and causing tsc and expo export to fail. Rename the file to src/navigation/index.tsx (or delete it and keep only src/navigation/index.tsx) and ensure it is imported correctly. Also replace the Unicode ellipsis character (\u2026) in the <Text>Loading…</Text> element with ASCII three periods ('Loading...') to avoid parsing issues.

src/screens/PolicyScreen.tsx: The checkbox styles use hard‑coded fontSize and margin values (box: { fontSize: 24, marginRight: 8 }, label: { fontSize: 16 }). All colors, font sizes and font families must be taken from the theme. Refactor the component to use react‑native‑paper Text variants or the useTheme hook for styling instead of manual numbers.
feedback: Static validation fails because of a JSX file with a .ts extension and hard‑coded style values. Fix the navigation file by renaming it to .tsx (or removing it) and replace the Unicode ellipsis with '...'. Refactor PolicyScreen styling to use the app theme via useTheme or Paper Text variants. After these changes the TypeScript compiler, expo export, and theme compliance checks should pass.
